newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed amid ample supply.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed amid ample supply.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed in moderate trade late this week, with the East and West Coasts falling on ample supply but the Gulf Coast rising on a modicum of demand, players said on Thursday.
Houston spot 380 CST, which dropped earlier this week, creeped up $2 to between $91 a tonne and $92 a tonne amid some interest. 180 CST was also up about $4 to $97/98, players said.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor dropped $4 to $106/111 due to ample supply and little demand. 180 CST was pegged about $3 lower at $111/112 a tonne.
